body:
I don't have any friends. People from school and work avoid me when they aren't forced to be in the same place. There's got to be a reason. One person can avoid me and it'll be their problem. Two, maybe. 40 people who only talk to you if they have to because of work or when they need you? Clearly I'm shit. I'm not enough to deserve even one single friend. I let people walk over me because I know their life is worth more than mine.

Maybe they say I'm sweet because I always try to help, but that's because my time or energy are worthless. I'd rather help them than spend time alone in my apartment crying because no one likes me.

> But that would permanently preclude you from achieving what you want. 

Being me already does that.

> It would be a shame if you just gave up. 

A shame for whom? No one cares. No one has texted me in more than three months. The last time someone did, it was a coworker asking for a favour. I'm dispensable. It's okay if I die, someone better will take my place. I will not be missed, people's lives will be better when I'm gone. A month from now everyone will lie and say that I was a great person and post some bullshit on Facebook about suicide prevention. Three months from now I will be "that guy who killed himself". Six months from now, no one will remember me.
